question: Can a ready-made temporal mask module retain the visible distant car as occlusion and frame position change, beyond copying or ordinary optical flow?
arms: SAM2.1HieraTiny frozen, only first manual targetmask, forwardpropagation all49frames, officialdefaultlogit>0, no corrections
Farneback backward current-to-previous flow, fixed(.5,3,15,3,5,1.2,0), nearest remap, zerooutside; recursivelywarp firstmask
acceptance: On every query with annotated visible target, recall>=0.5 and false-positive rate among known nontarget pixels<=0.1; missing denominator is unevaluable.

On the four later frames, SAM exceeds both full-frame static-copy and fixed optical-flow propagation in known-pixel targetIoU on at least3frames with visible target; require at least3such frames for this criterion. Absence frames reported separately, not counted as wins.
No new query masks, boxes, clicks, detector output or identity hints are supplied to the propagator. Weights and default zero logit threshold remain fixed.
Sequential frame extraction matches archived1159/1165 pixels; all inputs unchanged; report time and memory.
scope: One known video, four later frames not used to pick previous mask readers. Not a new-video generalization claim. New partial visible labels frozen before predictions. Past initialization is manual, not automatic. This tests a parallel mask component, not coreFlyVis or fullprojecttracker.
counterargument: A correct initialmask may still propagate to an occluder, or the target may leave the image. Keep these cases; examine false positives and absent-target outputs. It is possible fewer than3newqueries contain a visible target, making the increment criterion inconclusive.
